name: Heyah Family Education
description: Connect WorkBuddy to family learning records, homework, reports, questions and mastery evidence.
description_zh: 连接家庭学生档案、成长记录、作业、报告、题库与错题掌握证据，支持家庭私教工作流。
description_en: Connect family learning records, homework, reports, questions and mastery evidence.
examples_zh: 先读取 JOJO 最近的情况，帮我安排今天的学习
把老师发来的作业识别后同步到禾芽
根据最近错题生成一套针对性练习
总结孩子这个月的成长和下一步重点
examples_en: Read Jojo's recent learning context and plan today's study
Save the teacher's homework list to Heyah
Create targeted practice from recent wrong answers
Summarize this month's growth and next priorities
